confusions: The page menu collapses into a Menu button after the first screen, so I wasted several taps finding my way to another page.
The glossary is very long and takes many screens to scroll through to find one word.
I could not tell from the home page's Quick answers which ones led to the housing and renting figures, and I never found the renting share before running out of taps.
The Holidays and Earnings pages say 'not compared' and give two different surveys, which I had to read twice to understand.
On the who-pays page I could not tell at first which percentage was the top 1% and which was the richest fifth.
I never found anything on the site about why the number of jobs can be more than the number of people in work.
